title: Logistic Regression: Interpreting Predictions and Errors in Data Science

cues.en: This tutorial we will be talking about false positives and false negatives.
cues.zh: 這堂課會談偽陽性與偽陰性。

cues.en: As you remember where we were using the logistic regression function to observe where for random values
cues.zh: 還記得，我們使用邏輯斯迴歸函數，觀察自變數的隨機值，

cues.en: of the independent variable will end up in terms of y had so in terms of the predicted value for the
cues.zh: 會對應到哪個 y_hat，也就是應變數的

cues.en: dependent variable and we agreed that anything below the 50 percent line will be projected downwards
cues.zh: 預測值。我們說好，低於 50% 的內容都向下投影，

cues.en: onto the zero horizontal line and anything above the 50 percent line will be projected upwards onto
cues.zh: 到數值為 0 的水平線，高於 50% 則向上投影，

cues.en: the 100 percent horizontal line and that allowed us to turn probabilities into actual predictions.
cues.zh: 到 100% 的水平線，這樣就能把機率轉成實際預測，

cues.en: So either yes or no.
cues.zh: 也就是「是」或「否」。

cues.en: Now let's take a step back where did we get these four values from.
cues.zh: 現在退一步，這四個值從哪裡來？

cues.en: So we took four random values of the independent variable and we just had a look at what would happen
cues.zh: 我們從自變數隨意選了四個值，看看它們會怎麼樣，

cues.en: to them how we can use how we would use the logistic regression function to ascertain what probability they have and what y had values have.
cues.zh: 以及如何使用邏輯斯迴歸函數，求出機率與 y_hat。

cues.en: So we take another step back and we forget about these four random values and instead of taking four random values of the independent variable about we take for unknown values.
cues.zh: 再退一步，不管這四個隨機值，改成不是取隨機的未知值，

cues.en: In fact let's take four values for the independent variable.
cues.zh: 而是取四個自變數的值，

cues.en: From our data set.
cues.zh: 直接來自資料集。

cues.en: So let's just pick out four values that we really know they exist in our data set.
cues.zh: 也就是挑出四個確定存在於資料集的觀測值，

cues.en: And we use them to create this logistic regression.
cues.zh: 也是建立這個邏輯斯迴歸時用過的資料。

cues.en: And let's do the same thing with them let's see where they will end up.
cues.zh: 對它們做同樣操作，看看最後會落在哪裡，

cues.en: If we apply the model to them.
cues.zh: 也就是套用模型後的結果。

cues.en: And as you can see here the label of the vertical axis change too.
cues.zh: 可以看到，縱軸標籤也改變了，

cues.en: Why.
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because this is the we already know that in red is the actual value of the dependent variable because we know the result.
cues.zh: 因為我們已知道結果，紅色現在表示應變數的實際值。

cues.en: Those are the people on the bottom so observation is number one and number three they didn't take up the offer the email offer.
cues.zh: 下方的人，也就是觀測值 1 和 3，沒有接受電子郵件優惠，

cues.en: And the observations on the top people number two and four they did take up the email offer.
cues.zh: 上方的觀測值 2 和 4，則接受了優惠。

cues.en: So let's see what happens to them if we apply our logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 看看套用邏輯斯迴歸模型後會怎樣。

cues.en: So step number one would be to project these values onto the curve makes sense right.
cues.zh: 第一步，把這些值投影到曲線上，很合理吧？

cues.en: So we just want to see where they all end up on the curve that's all blue dots over there that's where they have been modeled by the curve.
cues.zh: 只想看看它們在曲線上的位置，也就是那些藍點，代表模型計算的結果。

cues.en: Now we can and from here we can say what the probabilities are you just have to project to the left and you can see approximately that for a version number one.
cues.zh: 現在可以從這裡知道機率，只要向左投影，就能大約看出觀測值 1 的機率，

cues.en: It's about maybe 20 percent 10 15 percent may say 15 percent observation or two.
It's about 40 percent absorption of three I would say about 70 percent observational before about 85 percent.
cues.zh: 大約 40%，觀測值 3 大約 70%，觀測值 4 則大約 85%。

cues.en: But we're not interested in probabilities per se.
cues.zh: 不過目前關心的不是機率本身，

cues.en: Right now what we want to get to is the actual y hat we want to see what the predictive value will be
cues.zh: 而是實際的 y_hat，想知道預測結果

cues.en: so we wanted to say we want to see if the model will tell us are these people going to take up off or not.
cues.zh: 會是什麼，也就是模型會說這些人接受優惠，還是不接受。

cues.en: And why would we want to do this is because we already know the result.
cues.zh: 為什麼想這樣做？因為已經知道結果了，

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: We already know what the result will be or was and we just want to see we want to kind of assess the model we want to see how well it's working and if it's going to make any mistakes.
cues.zh: 我們已知道實際結果，只是想評估模型，看看它表現如何、是否會犯錯。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and proceed with our logic for getting the y hat and what was the logic there.
cues.zh: 所以繼續按原本邏輯取得 y_hat，那個邏輯是什麼？

cues.en: Well the same thing that we discussed just a few minutes ago at the site of the Statoil anything we're using this arbitrary horizontal line 50 percent.
cues.zh: 就是幾分鐘前、這堂課開頭說過的，使用任意設定的 50% 水平線。

cues.en: So anything below this line is going to be projected onto the horizontal line which is zero.
cues.zh: 低於此線的結果投影到數值為 0 的水平線，

cues.en: So where we're saying that the offer is not going to be taken up and anything above the 50 percent line will be projected onto the horizontal line which is 1 or 100 percent.
cues.zh: 表示不會接受優惠；高於 50% 的結果投影到數值為 1，也就是 100% 的水平線，

cues.en: Where is saying that those people that end up on that line are different going to take up the offer .
cues.zh: 表示落在那條線的人會接受優惠。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and do that.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: There we go in gray We have our projections or our predicted values so white hat isn't great and it's
cues.zh: 好了，灰色表示投影，也就是預測值，因此 y_hat 是灰色。

cues.en: very interesting to see both why and why had on one chart so that means what actually happened is in red and what we predicted was going to happen isn't great.
cues.zh: 在同一張圖看 y 和 y_hat 很有趣：實際發生的事是紅色，預測會發生的是灰色。

cues.en: And right away you can see that for absorptions number one and number four.
cues.zh: 立刻可以看出，觀測值 1 和 4，

cues.en: So for those people in observation the morning before they we predicted correctly so we said for Person
cues.zh: 也就是那兩位，我們預測正確。對第 1 位，

cues.en: number one we predicted that she won't take up the offer.
cues.zh: 預測他不會接受優惠，

cues.en: And he actually did not take up the offer because the red mark is also on the same horizontal line.
cues.zh: 而他確實沒有，因為紅色標記也在同一條水平線。

cues.en: Now for observation and before.
cues.zh: 觀測值 4 也是如此，

cues.en: Same thing we predicted that that person will will take up the offer.
cues.zh: 預測這個人會接受優惠，

cues.en: And they did take up the offer.
cues.zh: 而他確實接受了。

cues.en: That's good but now let's have a look at the rest of them.
cues.zh: 這很好，現在看看其他人。

cues.en: Number three you can see that for observation number 2 the gray lines at the bottom.
cues.zh: 對觀測值 2，可以看到灰色標記位於下方，

cues.en: The green marks at the bottom meaning that the model is predicting for this person based on their gender based on their age.
cues.zh: 表示模型根據這個人的性別、年齡，

cues.en: Well in this case just age because we're doing a single variable logistic regression.
cues.zh: 在這裡其實只有年齡，因為是單一自變數邏輯斯迴歸，

cues.en: So based on their age this model is saying that this person is not going to take up the offer because the gray market is at the bottom.
cues.zh: 所以模型依年齡判斷，他不會接受優惠，因為灰色標記在下方。

cues.en: However we can see that the red mark is at the top meaning that this person did take up the offer and that means that the logistic regression made an error here.
cues.zh: 但紅色標記在上面，表示他實際接受了，這意味邏輯斯迴歸在這裡犯錯。

cues.en: And same thing for person number three.
cues.zh: 第 3 位也是相同情況，

cues.en: The gray market is at the top and that means that the models predicting that the person will will take up the offer but the red marks at the bottom meaning that the person didn't actually take up the offer
cues.zh: 灰色標記在上方，模型預測他會接受優惠，但紅色標記在下方，表示他其實沒有，

cues.en: and therefore the logistic regression made a mistake once again and these mistakes they actually have specific names.
cues.zh: 因此邏輯斯迴歸又犯了一次錯，而這些錯誤有特定名稱。

cues.en: So the top mistake over there is a false positive or a type 1 error.
cues.zh: 上面的錯誤是偽陽性，或稱第一類錯誤。

cues.en: What does post false positive mean.
cues.zh: 偽陽性是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well it means that we said we predicted a positive outcome but it was false.
cues.zh: 表示預測有正面結果，但預測是錯的，

cues.en: So we were.
cues.zh: 也就是我們，

cues.en: We predicted an effect that did not occur.
cues.zh: 預測了並未發生的效果。

cues.en: And the other mistake you see here has a different name is called a false negative.
cues.zh: 另一種錯誤有不同名稱，叫做偽陰性。

cues.en: So we predicted that there won't be an effect but the effect actually did occur.
cues.zh: 預測不會有效果，但效果實際發生了，

cues.en: So our prediction was negative meaning there won't be an effect but it was a false negative and it's called a type 2 type of error.
cues.zh: 因此是陰性的預測，也就是不會發生，但它是錯的，稱為第二類錯誤。

cues.en: And the way I personally remember them is it's important also to distinguish between the two.
cues.zh: 我個人有個記憶方式，區分兩者也很重要。

cues.en: The way I personally remember them is I think of type 1 as less dangerous than type 2 so type type 1
cues.zh: 我會把第一類想成比第二類不危險，所以第一類

cues.en: is less for me in my in my mind although it's not necessarily the case.
cues.zh: 在我心中相對較輕微，雖然不一定真的如此。

cues.en: But the way that's the way I remember them that type 1 is kind of like a warning.
cues.zh: 但這就是我的記法，第一類有點像警告，

cues.en: So that's why there's an ordered orange explanation mark and it's it's a false positive.
cues.zh: 所以畫成橘色驚嘆號，代表偽陽性。

cues.en: So basically you said something is going to happen but it didn't happen.
cues.zh: 基本上是你說事情會發生，但沒有發生。

cues.en: So you said maybe will be an earthquake but there wasn't an earthquake.
cues.zh: 例如說可能會有地震，實際卻沒地震，

cues.en: So you know that's not the end of the world.
cues.zh: 這還不到世界末日。

cues.en: But false negative is a bit worse in my view once again understanding because once you say something's not going to happen but it actually does happen then you can't even be prepared for it.
cues.zh: 但在我看來，偽陰性更糟一點，同樣只是記憶方式，因為說不會發生，卻真的發生，就連準備都無從做起。

cues.en: And that's why Type 2 is false negative and that's how I remember them personally.
cues.zh: 所以第二類是偽陰性，我個人就是這樣記。

cues.en: But once again it could be.
cues.zh: 但再次強調，它也可能，

cues.en: Absolutely.
cues.zh: 完全相反，

cues.en: They can both be pretty serious errors especially when you are dealing with like medical conclusions and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 兩者都可能是非常嚴重的錯誤，尤其涉及醫療判斷時。

cues.en: So those are false positives and false negatives.
cues.zh: 這就是偽陽性與偽陰性。

cues.en: We will be using them more when we talk about the confusion matra matrix in the next tutorial and I'll look for you next time.
cues.zh: 下一堂談混淆矩陣時會更常用到，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then happy analyzing
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你分析愉快。
